result.title: Symbolic Constraint Agents: Mining Formal Tool-Call Constraints to Prevent Agent Errors
result.summary: Symbolic constraints (programmatic, deterministic checks for tool calls) enable deterministic verification of LLM agents' tool calls, but existing approaches primarily enforce predefined safety policies rather than tool dependencies in complex tool environments. We explore whether symbolic constraints can be mined from environments and observations beyond predefined policies, and whether they can improve end-to-end task performance. We present Symbolic Constraint Agents (SCA), a framework that mines symbolic constraints from API documentation, refines them against execution traces, and checks the agent's tool calls with an SMT solver at runtime. A violation triggers a natural-language warning or, when the valid replacement is uniquely determined, an automatic repair. On AppWorld, refinement raises error-detection F1 from 37.0 to 58.3 on GPT-5.5 traces and from 39.3 to 61.9 on Qwen3.5-27B traces. At runtime, repair raises GPT-5.4-mini's task success by 5.4 points under a 40-call budget and 9.8 points when environment errors are hidden, while removing 59--87\% of failed calls across models, and transfers to $τ^2$-bench with gains of up to 5.6 points. These findings show that automatically acquired symbolic constraints can improve tool-calling reliability and task completion, particularly when failures are costly or difficult to diagnose.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Symbolic Constraint Agents 框架：从 API 文档挖掘符号约束、用执行轨迹精化，并在运行时用 SMT 求解器检查工具调用，违规时给出自然语言警告或在替换唯一时自动修复，在 AppWorld 与 τ²-bench 上提升任务成功率并减少失败调用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「从文档挖掘约束＋用轨迹精化＋运行时校验与自动修复」的流程可能为 LVR 的中间推理状态验证、轨迹监督与修复/停止决策提供可核查的方法线索；但对象是文本工具调用而非视觉 latent 状态，迁移性需人工判断。
